description: This file implements elliptic curve scalar multiplication using the wNAF (window Non-Adjacent Form) method, including precomputation and batch processing functions for elliptic curve points, specifically for the BoringSSL/OpenSSL cryptographic library.

methods.name: ec_compute_wNAF
methods.description: Computes the window Non-Adjacent Form (wNAF) representation of a scalar for elliptic curve scalar multiplication.

methods.name: compute_precomp
methods.description: Precomputes odd multiples of a given EC point for use in wNAF-based multiplication.

methods.name: lookup_precomp
methods.description: Looks up a precomputed EC point corresponding to a digit, handling negative digits by inverting the point.

methods.name: ec_GFp_mont_mul_public_batch
methods.description: Performs batch elliptic curve point multiplication using wNAF and precomputation for multiple scalars and points.
